title: GOP national seed analysis — depth 0
summary: The root pass establishes the national committee graph, current public leadership, four attributed claims, current FEC financial summaries, and four breadth-first depth-1 targets.

sources.title: Joe Gruters, a Trump ally, elected new head of Republican National Committee

provenance.method: primary-source OSINT and bounded graph extraction

data.question: What are the strongest public-source seeds for a recursive GOP AutoDig?
data.method: Official party pages, official platform text, FEC committee summaries, and attributed public reporting.
data.framework: Entity-first graph extraction with claims separated from verified organizational and financial facts.
data.scope: RNC, NRCC, NRSC, current national leadership, official policy claims, and 2025-2026 FEC summaries.
findings: The current RNC site identifies Joe Gruters as chairman and KC Crosbie as co-chair.
The 2024 platform provides explicit policy commitments and causal claims that must remain attributed claims until implementation and outcomes are separately established.
FEC summaries through May 31, 2026 show large affiliated-transfer, other-receipt, and disbursement totals across RNC, NRCC, and NRSC.
Transaction-level source committees, joint fundraising flows, vendors, and recipient normalization are the highest-value next recursion targets.
conclusions: The initial graph is sufficiently sourced to begin breadth-first expansion.
Campaign-finance summary categories identify leads but do not establish donor, vendor, or control relationships without itemized transactions.
The next pass should prioritize itemized FEC receipts and disbursements, then leadership/state-party governance.
recommendations: Run each depth as a separate published pass.
Normalize committee IDs before aggregating names.
Keep official rhetoric, implementation evidence, and outcome adjudication as separate document types.
counterarguments: FEC summary data can change as amended reports are filed.
The 2024 platform may not capture every current 2026 party position.
